author: OboroWolf
quote: 13 years in development, and this game gets released in deplorable condition, to the point where it doesn’t even run properly on the latest consoles. Game has tons of glitches, bugs, has  performance issues, and on top of that, they didn’t release a physical edition to save money. If you support this game, the entire gaming industry will see that consumers are willing to pay a lot of money for games that aren’t even released in a proper condition. DON’T SETTLE FOR LESS.
